description:
TSC is seeking entry level  Software Engineers  in  Silver Spring, MD  to support advanced concepts model and simulation development and execution for surface Navy radar and combat systems. The M&S effort is used for design, development, analytical evaluations of system performance, and systems engineering for sophisticated radar, communications and weapons systems.
 TSC has assembled a well-knit team of junior and senior system and software engineers that perform critical M&S development, execution, and analysis for US Navy and Missile Defense Agency customers.
 TSC offers a stable yet flexible working environment in an exciting industry with cutting edge defense technology, a competitive salary, and an excellent benefits package. Come and join our team!
 
 Responsibilities:   
 Model/component integration into large scale simulation; GUI, analysis tools, and various kinds of automation (build, test, etc.) development and maintenance.
 Duties include design/architecture contribution, capability implementation, testing, and bug/issue resolution.
 Significant interaction with other TSC radar system and modeling & simulation engineers as part of the job.
 Expected travel (up to 5%) will be to Navy facilities around the Washington, DC area. Farther travel is irregular.
 Assigned tasking will be at both individual and team levels.
 Porting code between Windows/Linux.
 
 Minimum Qualifications: 
 Bachelors or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or comparable technical degree well-grounded in Computer Programming.
 Skill in C/C++ or Java.
 Interest in Navy’s AEGIS Combat System and Defense technology.
 Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD clearance.
 U.S. Citizenship required.
 
 Preferred Qualifications:  
 Skill in Qt and Microsoft Visual Studio.
 Windows and Linux environments.
 
 In compliance with applicable pay transparency laws, the expected salary range for this position is $83,000 – $108,000 per year, depending on experience and location. This role is also eligible for an annual performance bonus and may include equity or incentive compensation as part of the total rewards package. 
 
 TSC Benefits: 
 TSC offers a stable work environment, a competitive salary, and a comprehensive benefit package; including Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP) participation, 401k Plan, Flexible Work Schedules, Tuition Reimbursement, Co-Sponsored Health Plan, Paid Leave and much more. TSC is a growing organization with unlimited opportunity!
 
 Applying to TSC: 
 Only those candidates invited for an interview will be contacted. Employment at TSC is contingent upon the successful completion of a comprehensive background check, security investigation, and a drug screening.
